If you plan to connect a cash drawer, verify that the printer has a compatible drawer port and that the POS software supports the setup. Also check the power adapter, plug type, included cables and any accessories listed by the supplier.

Install the correct driver or select the printer through the POS software, then print a test receipt before using it for live transactions. Load the thermal roll in the direction shown by the paper guide and keep the paper path clear. Store spare rolls away from direct sunlight, heat, moisture and friction. Keep the printer on a stable, dry counter, switch it off before cleaning and follow the manufacturer's instructions for paper jams and print-head care. Ask Stermont Arcade to confirm any unlisted specification before checkout.

hp-laserjet-mfp-m141w-wireless-mono-lase.heading: Everyday black-and-white office printing
paragraphs: The HP LaserJet MFP M141w combines monochrome laser printing, copying and flatbed scanning in one compact desktop device. It is intended for routine paperwork in a home office, small business, retail counter, school office or work-from-home setup. Typical jobs include invoices, quotations, letters, forms, school notes and delivery records. HP specifies black A4 print speeds of up to 20 pages per minute and print quality up to 600 x 600 dpi; actual speed varies with the document, software, driver and connection.

This is a black-and-white printer, not a colour photo printer. It does not provide automatic two-sided printing, so duplex pages need to be turned manually. HP lists a 150-sheet input tray and a 100-sheet output bin. The recommended monthly print volume is 100 to 1,000 pages; the maximum monthly duty cycle is a ceiling for comparison, not a recommended everyday target.

hp-laserjet-mfp-m141w-wireless-mono-lase.heading: Wireless setup, toner and purchase checks
paragraphs: The M141w supports Hi-Speed USB and 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi. Supported mobile printing options include the HP app, Apple AirPrint, Mopria and Wi-Fi Direct when used with compatible devices and software. Wireless reliability depends on router coverage, network settings and distance. Install the recommended HP software and confirm the printer is connected to the intended network. A USB cable is not listed among the standard box contents, so check whether one is needed for your setup.

HP identifies the HP 150A Black Original LaserJet Toner Cartridge, model W1500A, as the replacement toner for this printer series. Actual toner yield depends on page coverage and print settings. Keep the device on a stable, ventilated surface, use supported paper and follow HP's instructions when clearing jams or replacing toner. Before checkout, confirm the exact M141w model, included toner, power cord, warranty information and accessories required for your office.

t8-f10w-g13-uv-fly-killer-tubes-10w-2-pa.heading: Check the T8 F10W G13 tube size before ordering
paragraphs: This two-pack contains T8 F10W UV-A replacement tubes for compatible electric fly killers and insect light traps. The listed tube body length is approximately 330 mm, with an overall length of about 345 mm including the pins. The tube diameter is approximately 25 mm and the base is a G13 two-pin fitting.
The BL368 version is specified at a peak wavelength of about 368 nm. These are replacement lamps only; the electric fly killer unit, starter, glue boards and other accessories are not included.
bullets: Pack quantity: 2 replacement tubes.
Lamp type: T8 fluorescent UV-A, 10W each.
Base: G13 two-pin.
Approximate dimensions: 330 mm tube body; 345 mm including pins; 25 mm diameter.
Check your old tube and insect-killer model for wattage, length and cap type before buying.

t8-f10w-g13-uv-fly-killer-tubes-10w-2-pa.heading: Compatibility and safe replacement
paragraphs: T8 F10W G13 lamps are not interchangeable with every fly-killer tube. In particular, do not assume that a longer 15W T8 tube or a narrower T5 tube will fit. Compare the model marking and physical dimensions of your existing lamp before ordering.

Switch off and unplug the insect killer, allow it to cool, and handle the glass tube carefully. Fit only a compatible replacement and refit all protective guards before reconnecting power. Follow the insect-killer manufacturer's instructions and dispose of used fluorescent lamps responsibly.
bullets: Suitable only for devices designed for the matching T8 F10W G13 tube size.
Do not force the pins or glass tube into the lamp holder.
If the unit still fails after replacement, have the starter, wiring and fitting checked.

t8-f10w-g13-uv-fly-killer-tubes-10w-2-pa.heading: Order UV fly-killer replacement tubes in Kenya
paragraphs: Buy the T8 F10W G13 UV fly-killer replacement tube two-pack from Stermont Arcade for KSh 4,999. The listing is for two 10W replacement lamps. Confirm compatibility with your existing fly killer before checkout; ask Stermont Arcade if you need help checking the dimensions.

fumakilla-vape-mat-e-30-piece-refill-pac.heading: What is included in the 30-mat refill pack
paragraphs: The Fumakilla Vape Mat E refill contains 30 mosquito-repellent mats. It is a refill pack; the electric heater is not included. Check the model printed on your existing heater and use only the mat type specified for that device. Fumakilla cautions that mats and heaters from different systems may not deliver the intended performance.

Fumakilla's product information describes this mat format for adult mosquito control and states approximately 12 hours of use per mat. Actual performance depends on the room and conditions, so follow the instructions on the pack and heater rather than treating the stated duration as a guarantee.
bullets: 30 individual mats in one refill pack.
Designed for use with a compatible electric mat heater.
Check heater compatibility before ordering.

fumakilla-vape-mat-e-30-piece-refill-pac.heading: How to use and store the refill
paragraphs: Use the mat with a compatible Fumakilla electric heater indoors. Place the heater on a stable, level surface with clearance around it, connect it according to the device manual and switch it off when it is not required. Do not touch the heated plate or mat while in use; allow the device to cool before replacing a mat.

Keep unused mats in their packaging and store them away from children, pets, food and direct heat. Do not use the mat in an aquarium or insect-rearing area: Fumakilla warns that the vapour can affect fish, aquatic organisms and insects. Follow all label precautions and ventilate the room where the product instructions require it.
bullets: Keep the heater and refill out of children's reach.
Do not use in rooms containing aquariums or insect enclosures.
Read the product label and heater manual before use.

moskill-aerosol-750ml-jumbo-pack.heading: What the 750ml jumbo aerosol is designed to do
paragraphs: Moskill Aerosol 750ml Jumbo Pack is a large-format household public-health aerosol made by Osho Chemical Industries. The manufacturer describes Moskill Aerosol for control of mosquitoes and other flying or crawling insects in domestic environments. It can be used as a conventional aerosol spray or, where the label permits, as a total-release product using its press-and-twist nozzle.

Osho states that one canister can cover up to 300 square metres in 2 minutes 52 seconds, and that a 30-second burst covers 50 square metres. These are manufacturer figures, not a guarantee for every room; room layout, ventilation and application conditions affect results.
bullets: 750ml jumbo-size aerosol can.
Manufacturer: Osho Chemical Industries.
PCPB public-health register lists Moskill Aerosol as PCPB(CR)1002.

moskill-aerosol-750ml-jumbo-pack.heading: Read the label and prepare the room before use
paragraphs: Before spraying, read the full product label and confirm that the treatment method is suitable for the room and target pest. Remove or cover food, utensils and exposed surfaces as directed. Keep people and pets out of the treatment area during application and for the re-entry period stated on the label. Ventilate the room thoroughly before allowing people back inside.

Aerosol cans are pressurised and flammable. Keep the can away from heat, sparks and open flames, do not puncture or burn it, and store it in a cool place out of children's reach. Do not spray directly onto people, animals, food or aquariums. Follow the label for safe disposal.
bullets: Use only as directed on the product label.
Keep away from heat and open flames.
Store securely away from children and pets.

mos-kill-mat-vapouriser-electric-mosquit.heading: What this electric mat vapouriser includes
paragraphs: The Mos-Kill Mat Vapouriser is the electric heater used with compatible Mos-Kill mosquito-repellent mats. This listing is for the plug-in vapouriser device, not a pack of replacement mats. Osho Chemical Industries describes it for use in enclosed indoor surroundings such as homes, hotels and offices. The manufacturer states that each compatible Mos-Kill mat can provide up to 10 hours of use.

The device is rated at 220–240V and 50Hz. Check the electrical rating on the unit and make sure the supply matches before plugging it in. Replacement mats are sold separately, so confirm you have compatible mats available before use.
bullets: Electric mosquito mat vapouriser device.
Rated 220–240V, 50Hz.
Use with compatible Mos-Kill mats; mats are sold separately.

mos-kill-mat-vapouriser-electric-mosquit.heading: Using the heater safely indoors
paragraphs: Place the vapouriser on a stable, dry and level surface, away from bedding, curtains, paper, liquids and other materials that could be affected by heat. Use only the mat type specified for this device; do not substitute liquid refills or mats intended for another heater. Switch off and unplug the unit before replacing a mat or cleaning it, and allow the heating plate to cool before touching it.

Keep the powered device out of children's reach and away from pets and water. Do not use a damaged plug or cable. Follow the instructions supplied with the vapouriser and the mat label, and switch the device off when it is not required.
bullets: Keep the unit dry and away from water.
Unplug and allow it to cool before changing a mat.
Follow the device and mat instructions.

resolve-6-dust-insecticide-12-x-10g-sach.heading: Resolve 6% Dust 12 x 10g pack details
paragraphs: This Resolve 6% Dust listing is for one display box containing 12 individual 10g sachets, giving 120g of product in total. Osho Chemical Industries lists it as a public-health insecticide for household control of cockroaches, ants, fleas and houseflies. The Kenyan Pest Control Products Board public-health register lists Resolve 6% Dust under PCPB(CR)2009.

The registered formulation is listed with carbaryl 50g/kg and lambda-cyhalothrin 10g/kg. This is a dust formulation, not a spray or liquid concentrate. Check the pack and the label before use, and do not substitute instructions from another insecticide or another Resolve pack.
bullets: 12 sachets per display box.
Each sachet contains 10g; 120g total.
Listed for household cockroaches, ants, fleas and houseflies.

resolve-6-dust-insecticide-12-x-10g-sach.heading: Use the insecticide dust with care
paragraphs: Apply only by the method and at the rate stated on the product label. Keep the dust away from food, drinking water, utensils, children's toys and animal feed. Avoid breathing dust or allowing it to contact skin and eyes; use the protective measures specified on the pack. Do not apply to people or pets.

Keep children and pets away from treated areas for the period stated on the label. Store unopened sachets in their original box in a cool, dry, locked place, separate from food and medicines. Dispose of empty sachets and leftover product according to the label and local requirements.
bullets: Read the label before opening or applying a sachet.
Keep away from children, pets, food and water.
Store securely in the original packaging.

vectorfog-dc20-cordless-ulv-fogger.heading: Cordless ULV fogging for mobile treatment work
paragraphs: The VectorFog DC20 is a battery-powered ultra-low-volume (ULV) fogger for professional operators who need to move around a treatment area without a mains power cable. Its 12V operation and 2-litre tank make it a portable option for suitable pest-management and disinfection work. Choose a fogger only after checking the target site, treatment objective and application method approved on the product label.

Published DC20 specifications state a spray distance of about 2–7 metres and droplet sizes of 5–50 microns. Actual coverage depends on the liquid formulation, nozzle condition, airflow and site conditions. ULV fogging does not replace inspection, sanitation, exclusion or targeted residual treatment when those methods are required.
bullets: Cordless 12V operation and 2-litre tank.
Published droplet-size range: 5–50 microns.
Published spray-distance range: approximately 2–7 metres.

vectorfog-dc20-cordless-ulv-fogger.heading: Battery, handling and safe application
paragraphs: The supplier lists up to 40 minutes of continuous operation and approximately 3 hours for charging. These are indicative figures; battery condition and operating conditions affect runtime. The listed weight is about 3.2 kg and dimensions are approximately 480 × 250 × 200 mm. Confirm the exact model, battery, charger, warranty and package contents before ordering.

Use only formulations whose labels explicitly approve ULV application. Follow the label and safety data sheet for dilution, personal protective equipment, ventilation, exposure controls and re-entry intervals. Keep people, animals, food and unprotected surfaces clear as directed; never assume every insecticide or disinfectant can be fogged.
bullets: Confirm battery, charger, warranty and spare-parts availability.
Follow the chemical label and safety data sheet for every application.

vectorfog-dc20-cordless-ulv-fogger.heading: Choosing a cordless ULV fogger
paragraphs: A cordless ULV fogger is suited to work where mobility is important and the treatment protocol calls for a fine aerosol. It differs from a thermal fogger, which uses heat, and a conventional pressure sprayer, which generally applies larger droplets to selected surfaces. Match the machine to the pest, target site, approved chemical and operator controls.

The Stermont Arcade price uses a US$730 international reference plus a 50% markup, converted using the working exchange rate. This is a pricing benchmark, not a confirmed Kenyan landed cost or local stock confirmation. Check availability, delivery, taxes and warranty before ordering.

pegasus-500sc-insecticide-100ml.heading: Pegasus 500SC 100ml: formulation, pack and crop-protection role
paragraphs: Pegasus 500SC is a suspension-concentrate insecticide containing diafenthiuron at 500 g/L. This Stermont Arcade listing is specifically for the 100ml pack, matching the pack shown by the Kenyan supplier. The supplier describes the product for diamondback moth, cabbage butterfly, white butterfly and cabbage moth lesser armyworm in cabbage, kale, broccoli and cauliflower. It also identifies use against thrips and black bean aphids in French beans, and mites, whiteflies and aphids in roses and other ornamentals. These are supplier-listed uses, not a substitute for the current approved Kenyan label.

When comparing Pegasus with other crop-protection products, check the active ingredient and concentration rather than relying on a similar brand name or bottle colour. Diafenthiuron 500 g/L and the SC formulation identify this product. The 100ml pack is different from larger packs such as 1 litre; confirm the pack size on the bottle and invoice before accepting delivery. Agropests lists the 100ml pack at KSh 730, which is the source price used for this listing's cost basis.
bullets: Pack listed: 100ml; formulation: suspension concentrate (SC).
Active ingredient stated by the supplier: diafenthiuron 500 g/L.

pegasus-500sc-insecticide-100ml.heading: Buying, storage and responsible use in Kenya
paragraphs: Before ordering, confirm that the product is currently registered for the intended crop and pest in Kenya and that the exact pack bears an approved label. The label is the authority for permitted crops, target pests, mixing instructions, application method, personal protective equipment, re-entry interval and pre-harvest interval. Do not infer a dose from another formulation or from a product with a similar name. If the label does not cover the intended use, do not apply it.

Keep the container in its original packaging with the label readable. Store it securely, away from children, animals, food, feed, water sources and direct sunlight, following the label's temperature and handling instructions. Do not reuse an empty pesticide container. Prevent spills from reaching drains, rivers, ponds or irrigation channels, and follow local guidance for disposal. Farmers should consider pest scouting, field hygiene and resistance-management advice from a qualified Kenyan agronomist before selecting a treatment.
bullets: Check registration, label directions, PPE, re-entry and pre-harvest intervals.

ridomil-gold-mz-68wg-fungicide-1kg.heading: Ridomil Gold MZ 68WG 1kg: active ingredients and formulation
paragraphs: Ridomil Gold MZ 68WG is a water-dispersible granule fungicide combining metalaxyl-M at 40 g/kg with mancozeb at 640 g/kg. The two active ingredients provide different roles in the formulation: the supplier describes metalaxyl-M as systemic and mancozeb as a contact protectant that forms a film on plant surfaces. This combination is intended for management of diseases caused by oomycete fungi, including late blight and downy mildew. The listing on this page is for the 1kg pack, not the smaller 50g or 250g sizes also sold by some Kenyan suppliers.

Agropests lists the 1kg pack at KSh 2,950 and describes crops including potatoes, grapes, tobacco, vegetables, citrus, tomatoes, soybeans, turf and ornamentals. Crop suitability depends on the approved label and local registration conditions. Buyers should compare the formulation code, active-ingredient strengths and pack weight on the product label before ordering, especially when checking prices across different pack sizes.
bullets: Metalaxyl-M 40 g/kg plus mancozeb 640 g/kg, as stated by the supplier.
Pack shown: 1kg water-dispersible granules (WG).

ridomil-gold-mz-68wg-fungicide-1kg.heading: Choosing the pack and checking the Kenyan label
paragraphs: The 1kg pack may suit a farm or professional user who has confirmed the required quantity from a crop-protection plan. It should not be selected simply because the unit price appears lower than a smaller pack. Calculate the quantity needed from the label-approved crop, disease, application method and area, and avoid preparing more spray mixture than can be used as directed. Never transfer granules into an unlabelled container or use a household measuring utensil for pesticide handling.

Before use, verify that Ridomil Gold MZ 68WG is currently registered for the intended crop and disease in Kenya. Follow the label for mixing, protective clothing, equipment cleaning, re-entry interval, pre-harvest interval and any limits on the number of applications. Rotate fungicides according to a resistance-management programme rather than repeating the same mode of action without advice. Good field sanitation, crop monitoring and suitable cultural practices remain important parts of disease management.
bullets: Use the 1kg pack only after confirming the label-approved quantity and use.
Keep the product sealed, dry and securely stored in its original packaging.

copchem-50-wp-copper-oxychloride-fungici.heading: COPCHEM 50%WP 1kg: product identity and formulation
paragraphs: COPCHEM 50%WP is listed by M-Tolori as a copper oxychloride fungicide in a wettable-powder formulation. The supplier's product page identifies the active ingredient as copper oxychloride and shows the 1kg pack at KSh 1,470. This Stermont Arcade listing keeps the brand and pack identity visible so buyers can distinguish it from other copper fungicides, copper-based foliar products and similarly named formulations. A 50%WP designation refers to a wettable powder formulation; it should not be confused with a liquid suspension concentrate or a different copper compound.

Copper-based crop-protection products are not interchangeable solely because they contain copper. The exact active ingredient, concentration, formulation, registered crops and approved disease claims must match the product label. The supplier's short listing does not provide a complete crop-use schedule, so this page does not invent a target crop, disease, application rate or pre-harvest interval. Buyers should request the current product label if those details are not clear on the pack.
bullets: Supplier-listed product: COPCHEM 50%WP, 1kg.
Supplier-listed active ingredient: copper oxychloride; formulation: wettable powder.

copchem-50-wp-copper-oxychloride-fungici.heading: How to assess the pack before ordering
paragraphs: Check that the container is sealed, correctly labelled and carries the same product name and formulation as the order. Read the label for registration details, approved crops and diseases, mixing sequence, compatibility restrictions, protective equipment, re-entry interval and pre-harvest interval. Do not assume the directions for another copper oxychloride brand apply to COPCHEM. If the supplier cannot provide the label or clarify the intended use, pause and obtain advice from a qualified agronomist or the product registrant before application.

Wettable powders require careful handling to minimise dust exposure during measuring and mixing. Use the protective equipment specified on the label, avoid inhaling dust and keep people and animals away from the preparation area. Prevent spray drift and runoff into ponds, streams, drains and other water sources. Clean equipment and dispose of empty packaging only as the label and local rules direct. Store the product in its original sealed pack in a dry, secure place, away from food, feed and children.
bullets: Ask for the current approved label if crop-specific directions are not supplied.

ridomil-gold-mz-68wg-fungicide-50g.heading: Ridomil Gold MZ 68WG 50g: compact pack details
paragraphs: This listing is for the 50g sachet of Ridomil Gold MZ 68WG, a water-dispersible granule fungicide containing metalaxyl-M 40 g/kg and mancozeb 640 g/kg. Agropests lists this exact pack as in stock at KSh 200. The supplier describes the product for diseases caused by oomycete fungi, including late blight, damping-off and downy mildew. It also lists crops such as potatoes, grapes, tobacco, vegetables, citrus, tomatoes, soybeans, turf and ornamentals. Confirm the intended crop and disease against the current Kenyan label.

A 50g pack is not interchangeable with a 250g or 1kg pack when calculating quantities. The supplier's product information gives a reference of 50g per 20 litres of water, but users must follow the current approved label for the specific crop, application method and situation. Do not scale or alter a rate based only on pack size.
bullets: Pack: 50g; formulation: water-dispersible granules (WG).
Active ingredients: metalaxyl-M and mancozeb.

ridomil-gold-mz-68wg-fungicide-50g.heading: Before ordering or applying the 50g sachet
paragraphs: Check that the sachet is sealed, labelled and within its stated shelf life. Verify the registration status and permitted crop use in Kenya, then read the label for mixing instructions, protective clothing, re-entry interval, pre-harvest interval and disposal requirements. The seller's page is useful for identifying the product and pack, but the product label is the authority for safe use. If the label is missing or unreadable, ask the supplier for clarification before using it.

Store the sachet in its original packaging in a dry, locked place away from children, animals, food, feed and water. Avoid breathing dust when handling granules, use the label-specified protective equipment and keep mixing or washing water away from streams and drains. Use crop monitoring and agronomic advice to decide whether a fungicide is needed, and rotate modes of action according to a resistance-management plan. Stermont Arcade's KSh 230 selling price is based on the KSh 200 supplier listing plus a 15% markup. Confirm stock and delivery before payment.
bullets: Use the current Kenyan label for crop approvals, rate and pre-harvest interval.

ridomil-gold-mz-68wg-fungicide-250g.heading: Ridomil Gold MZ 68WG 250g: pack and composition
paragraphs: The 250g pack of Ridomil Gold MZ 68WG contains the same stated formulation as the smaller and larger packs: metalaxyl-M 40 g/kg plus mancozeb 640 g/kg in water-dispersible granules. Agropests lists the 250g pack in stock at KSh 895. Its product description identifies use against oomycete diseases such as late blight, damping-off and downy mildew, with supplier-listed crops including potatoes, grapes, tobacco, vegetables, citrus, tomatoes, soybeans, turf and ornamentals.

Choose the pack size only after confirming the quantity required for the label-approved treatment. The 250g pack is larger than the 50g sachet and smaller than the 1kg pack; it does not change the product concentration or label directions. Compare the exact pack weight and formulation code on the container when checking offers from different suppliers.
bullets: Pack shown: 250g; formulation: WG.
Supplier-listed source price: KSh 895.

ridomil-gold-mz-68wg-fungicide-250g.heading: Practical checks for buyers and crop users
paragraphs: Before ordering, confirm that the product is registered for the intended crop and disease in Kenya. Read the approved label for application rate, water volume, mixing order, protective equipment, re-entry interval and pre-harvest interval. The supplier mentions a 50g per 20-litre knapsack reference, but the current label must determine the correct use for the crop and target disease. Do not apply it to a crop or situation that is not listed on the approved label.

Keep the granules in their original sealed pack, stored dry and securely away from food, feed, children and animals. Avoid dust exposure during measuring, prevent spills and washings from entering waterways, and dispose of packaging as directed by the label and local rules. Good sanitation, crop inspection and sound irrigation management remain important in disease prevention. Stermont Arcade calculates the KSh 1,029.25 selling price from the KSh 895 supplier listing with a 15% markup. Confirm the pack, stock and delivery details before checkout.
bullets: Check the exact 250g label and stock status before purchase.
Follow label directions and environmental precautions.

score-250ec-fungicide-1l.heading: Score 250 EC 1L: active ingredient and product identity
paragraphs: Score 250 EC 1L is an emulsifiable-concentrate fungicide containing difenoconazole at 250 g/L. Agropests lists the one-litre pack in stock at KSh 8,000. The supplier describes Score as a systemic triazole fungicide for leaf rust and leaf-spot diseases in vegetables and ornamentals, and also refers to powdery mildew, Alternaria and rusts in fruit trees and pulses. The 1L pack is distinct from the 20ml and 100ml packs, so compare the exact volume and formulation when reviewing supplier prices.

The supplier's product information explains that difenoconazole interferes with sterol biosynthesis in fungal cell membranes. This is product information, not a guarantee of control in every crop or field condition. Disease identification, crop stage, weather, resistance history and the approved label all affect whether the product is appropriate.
bullets: Pack: 1 litre; active ingredient: difenoconazole 250 g/L.
Formulation: emulsifiable concentrate (EC).

score-250ec-fungicide-1l.heading: Planning a purchase and responsible fungicide use
paragraphs: A one-litre pack should be purchased only when the planned, label-approved use justifies that quantity. Check the crop, target disease, dose, spray interval, maximum number of applications and pre-harvest interval on the current Kenyan label. The supplier lists a reference rate of 0.5 litres per hectare, but do not rely on a general web listing in place of the label for your crop. Ask a qualified agronomist if disease symptoms are uncertain or if resistance-management advice is needed.

Store Score in its original closed container in a secure, well-ventilated area away from children, animals, food, feed and water. Wear the protective equipment stated on the label, avoid spray drift and prevent washings from reaching drains or waterways. Rotate fungicide modes of action and combine chemical decisions with crop monitoring and sanitation. Stermont Arcade's KSh 9,200 selling price uses the supplier's KSh 8,000 listing plus a 15% markup. Confirm the 1L pack, current stock and delivery terms before payment.
bullets: Verify crop approval, application instructions and pre-harvest interval on the label.
Compare the 1L pack only with offers for the same formulation and volume.

bestox-100ec-insecticide-100ml.heading: Bestox 100EC 100ml: formulation and listed target pests
paragraphs: Bestox 100EC 100ml is an emulsifiable-concentrate insecticide containing alphacypermethrin 10%, as stated by Agropests. The supplier lists the 100ml bottle in stock at KSh 340 and describes it for caterpillars, aphids, cutworms, fruit flies, thrips, bollworms, maize stalk borers and whiteflies. The pack on this page is 100ml; check the bottle and invoice to make sure it is not confused with the 50ml, 1-litre or larger packs sold elsewhere.

The supplier page gives a reference application rate of 10ml per 20 litres of water and a three-day pre-harvest interval. These are supplier-listed details and must be checked against the current approved Kenyan label for the crop and target pest. Do not assume the same directions apply to another formulation or product with a similar trade name.
bullets: Pack: 100ml; active ingredient: alphacypermethrin 10%.
Liquid formulation: emulsifiable concentrate (EC).

bestox-100ec-insecticide-100ml.heading: Check the label, handling requirements and pack size
paragraphs: Before buying, confirm that Bestox 100EC is currently registered for the intended crop and pest in Kenya. Read the approved label for the crop list, dose, spray volume, protective equipment, re-entry interval and pre-harvest interval. Insecticides should be selected after identifying the pest and assessing whether treatment is necessary; avoid unnecessary spraying and follow resistance-management advice from a qualified agronomist.

Keep the bottle in its original packaging with the label intact. Store it locked away from children, animals, food, feed and water, and follow the label for safe mixing, equipment cleaning and disposal. Avoid drift onto neighbouring crops, pollinators, people and water bodies. The supplier's KSh 340 listing is used as the source price; the Stermont Arcade selling price of KSh 391 includes a 15% markup. Confirm current availability, the exact 100ml bottle and delivery arrangements before checkout.
bullets: Use only for label-approved crops and pests, with the required protective equipment.
Keep the container sealed and securely stored after purchase.

dap-18-46-0-fertilizer-50kg.heading: Using DAP 18-46-0 in a planting programme
paragraphs: DAP is a concentrated phosphate fertiliser containing 18% nitrogen and 46% phosphate. It is commonly selected as a basal input when soil analysis and the crop plan indicate a need for phosphorus at establishment. Farmers comparing DAP in Kenya should check the nutrient grade and bag weight, not just the product name.

Because this formulation does not declare potassium, it should not be treated as a complete NPK fertiliser. Plan other nutrients separately where soil tests or agronomic advice show they are required. Avoid placing granules directly against seed or young roots unless the product label specifically permits that placement.
bullets: Confirm the field rate from the current label and soil analysis.
Keep the 50kg bag dry, raised off the floor and resealed after opening.

dap-18-46-0-fertilizer-50kg.heading: What to check before ordering a 50kg bag
paragraphs: The 50kg pack is intended for farm-scale procurement. Compare the cost per kilogram and delivery arrangements for your location, especially when planning several bags for a larger field. Ask the supplier to confirm stock and the product batch before arranging collection or delivery.

Good fertiliser planning matches the nutrient requirement to the field rather than applying the same blend everywhere. Keep a simple record of the area treated, date and rate so future applications can be reviewed against crop performance and soil-test results.
bullets: Check that the bag label states DAP 18:46:0.
Store separately from food, animal feed and household supplies.

elgon-thabiti-can-26-fertilizer-50kg.heading: Elgon Thabiti CAN for nitrogen top-dressing
paragraphs: Elgon Thabiti CAN is listed as a 26% nitrogen top-dressing fertiliser in a 50kg bag. Calcium ammonium nitrate is selected when a crop programme calls for additional nitrogen after establishment. The correct timing depends on the crop, growth stage, rainfall and the nutrient status of the field.

Use the product as a targeted nutrient input rather than assuming every crop needs the same amount. Soil testing and the current label help determine whether a nitrogen application is appropriate. Avoid spreading immediately before heavy rain, and do not leave concentrated fertiliser in direct contact with stems or seed.
bullets: Check the 26% nitrogen grade and 50kg net weight on the sack.
Use a calibrated measure or spreader for even application.

elgon-thabiti-can-26-fertilizer-50kg.heading: Buying and storing CAN in Kenya
paragraphs: A 50kg bag suits growers managing larger plots or replenishing farm stores. Before purchase, compare the exact grade, pack size, source price and delivery cost. Ask the seller to confirm availability because fertiliser stock and retail prices can change during planting seasons.

Keep the bag in a cool, dry, well-ventilated store, protected from moisture and contamination. Close opened packaging securely and keep fertiliser away from children, animals, food and feed. Follow the supplier label and local agronomic advice for handling and field use.
bullets: Record the date and field where the nitrogen was applied.
Do not substitute CAN for another fertiliser without checking the nutrient analysis.

ruiru-urea-46-n-fertilizer-50kg.heading: Ruiru Urea 46% N for crop nutrition
paragraphs: Ruiru Urea is a concentrated nitrogen fertiliser with a listed grade of 46% nitrogen. It is commonly used as a top-dressing input where the crop programme identifies a need for additional nitrogen to support vegetative growth. The 50kg bag is suited to farm-scale purchasing and planned field applications.

Urea is not a complete fertiliser because it supplies nitrogen rather than a balanced range of nutrients. Use it as part of a wider nutrient plan based on soil condition, crop demand and the label. Avoid direct contact with seed or plant stems, and incorporate or time the application as recommended.
bullets: Check soil-test results before deciding on the nitrogen rate.
Keep the 50kg sack dry and tightly closed between uses.

ruiru-urea-46-n-fertilizer-50kg.heading: Choosing the right time and handling the bag
paragraphs: Timing matters: nitrogen losses can increase when urea is left exposed on the soil surface under unsuitable conditions. Follow the label or an agronomist's recommendation for placement and timing, taking rainfall and irrigation into account. Do not use a general rate copied from another crop or field.

When comparing urea prices in Kenya, verify the 46% N grade and the 50kg pack before paying. Store fertiliser away from moisture and incompatible materials, and maintain records of the application date, rate and treated area.
bullets: Use protective gloves when handling fertiliser granules.
Avoid applying more nitrogen than the crop and soil require.

falcon-npk-17-17-17-fertilizer-50kg.heading: Balanced NPK 17:17:17 for a complete nutrient blend
paragraphs: Falcon NPK 17:17:17 is a granular compound fertiliser with equal listed proportions of nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium. This balanced grade may suit a crop programme that requires all three primary nutrients together. The 50kg bag is designed for farm use where a compound blend is more practical than applying separate nutrient sources.

The presence of three nutrients does not mean the same rate is suitable for every crop. Soil analysis, crop stage and expected nutrient removal should guide the application. Compare the declared nutrient analysis on the sack with the recommendation for your field before choosing this blend.
bullets: Verify the 17:17:17 grade and Falcon branding on delivery.
Use the label rate and spread evenly across the intended area.

falcon-npk-17-17-17-fertilizer-50kg.heading: Planning a 50kg fertiliser purchase
paragraphs: When buying NPK 17:17:17 in Kenya, compare the exact bag weight, price and delivery terms. The source listing identifies the 50kg pack; confirm that the bag received matches that pack rather than a smaller retail unit. Keep the invoice and batch details for your farm records.

Store granular fertiliser in a dry place, raised from damp floors and protected from rain. Reseal any opened sack to reduce moisture exposure. For fields with specific nutrient deficiencies, ask an agronomist whether a different NPK ratio or a single-nutrient fertiliser would better match the soil test.
bullets: Record the field, crop and application date.
Do not assume a balanced blend replaces all secondary or micronutrients.

npk-23-23-0-basal-fertilizer-50kg.heading: NPK 23:23:0 as a nitrogen and phosphorus source
paragraphs: NPK 23:23:0 is a granular fertiliser supplying nitrogen and phosphorus, with no declared potassium in the grade. It is generally considered for basal programmes where the soil and crop plan call for these nutrients and potassium is already adequate or supplied separately. The 50kg pack is intended for larger farm requirements.

Check the nutrient balance before selecting this product. A high phosphorus grade is not automatically suitable for every field, and excess application can create nutrient imbalance. Use a soil test, crop recommendation and the current product label to determine whether this formulation fits the intended planting programme.
bullets: Confirm that the sack states NPK 23:23:0 and 50kg.
Plan potassium separately if the crop or soil requires it.

npk-23-23-0-basal-fertilizer-50kg.heading: How to compare basal fertiliser options
paragraphs: Compare NPK 23:23:0 with DAP, NPK 17:17:17 and other basal blends by looking at the nutrient analysis and the field requirement. Price per bag alone does not show the cost per unit of nutrient delivered. The correct comparison includes application rate, transport and any complementary fertiliser needed.

Keep the product dry and protected from contamination. Apply it in the manner shown on the label, taking care with placement near seed and young roots. Retain the bag or a photograph of its analysis panel so the nutrient grade can be checked later.
bullets: Base the purchase on a field-specific nutrient plan.
Ask the supplier to confirm stock before arranging delivery.

mop-60-potash-fertilizer-50kg.heading: MOP 60% for potassium supply
paragraphs: MOP 60er Kali is a potassium chloride fertiliser containing 60% water-soluble potassium oxide. It is used to supply potassium in crop programmes where a chloride-containing source is suitable. Potassium is an essential plant nutrient, but crop tolerance to chloride varies, so this product should not be selected without considering the crop.

The 50kg pack is suitable for farm-scale use. Compare it with sulphate of potash where chloride sensitivity is a concern or where the nutrient plan calls for sulphur. The correct choice depends on the crop, soil test and fertiliser programme rather than the bag price alone.
bullets: Check crop tolerance to chloride before choosing MOP.
Confirm the 60% K₂O grade on the sack.

mop-60-potash-fertilizer-50kg.heading: Storage and application checks for potash
paragraphs: Use the recommended rate and timing from the product label or qualified agronomic guidance. Avoid over-applying potassium because excess nutrients can interfere with uptake of other elements. Record the field and application date so the fertiliser programme can be reviewed against subsequent soil tests.

Keep the 50kg bag sealed and dry in storage. The supplier lists this product as a granular fertiliser; inspect the sack for damage before accepting delivery and keep it away from water, food and animal feed.
bullets: Use a clean, dry spreader for granular fertiliser.
Compare MOP with chloride-free potassium sources when appropriate.

sulphate-of-potash-sop-fertilizer-25kg.heading: Sulphate of Potash as a chloride-free potassium source
paragraphs: Sulphate of Potash, commonly shortened to SOP, supplies potassium together with sulphur. It is considered where the crop programme requires potassium but the grower wants to avoid adding chloride from MOP. The listed K+S product is offered in a 25kg bag for farm and horticultural use.

Check the declared nutrient analysis on the product label before application. SOP is not automatically the best choice for every crop or soil; the nutrient requirement, existing soil potassium and cost per unit of nutrient should guide the decision. Use the label rate and timing for the intended crop.
bullets: Choose SOP where a sulphate-based potassium source fits the crop plan.
Keep the 25kg bag protected from moisture.

sulphate-of-potash-sop-fertilizer-25kg.heading: Comparing SOP with other potassium fertilisers
paragraphs: Farmers comparing SOP, MOP and potassium nitrate should check the accompanying nutrients as well as potassium concentration. SOP supplies sulphur, while MOP supplies chloride and potassium, and potassium nitrate supplies nitrogen as well. These differences matter when building a balanced nutrient programme.

Before ordering in Kenya, confirm the exact pack size, supplier stock and delivery charge. Keep the product label for reference and avoid blending concentrated fertilisers without checking compatibility. A soil test and crop-specific recommendation can help prevent unnecessary applications.
bullets: Check whether the field also needs sulphur.
Do not use a generic rate for every crop.

mono-ammonium-phosphate-map-fertilizer-2.heading: MAP for soluble nitrogen and phosphorus
paragraphs: Mono Ammonium Phosphate, or MAP, is a water-soluble fertiliser supplying nitrogen and a concentrated source of phosphorus. It is used in crop nutrition programmes where early root establishment or another growth stage requires readily available phosphorus. The 25kg Cropcare pack is listed for growers who use soluble fertilisers in managed feeding programmes.

MAP should be selected according to the crop's nutrient requirement and the water quality of the irrigation system. Check the exact analysis printed on the bag, since formulations can differ by supplier. Use the product label for dilution and application rates rather than estimating from another MAP product.
bullets: Confirm the MAP grade and water-soluble formulation before mixing.
Use clean water and follow the label's dissolution instructions.

mono-ammonium-phosphate-map-fertilizer-2.heading: Fertigation compatibility and storage
paragraphs: Phosphate fertilisers can react with calcium-containing products in concentrated stock solutions. Check compatibility guidance before combining MAP with calcium nitrate or other fertilisers, and use separate stock tanks where the technical instructions require them. This helps reduce the risk of precipitate forming in irrigation equipment.

The 25kg pack should be stored in a dry, secure area. Reseal opened packaging and keep it away from moisture. When comparing MAP prices in Kenya, consider the nutrient analysis, pack weight and delivery cost together.
bullets: Do a small compatibility check before preparing a tank mix.
Keep application records for each fertigation cycle.

yaratera-calcinit-calcium-nitrate-fertil.heading: YaraTera Calcinit for calcium and nitrate nitrogen
paragraphs: YaraTera Calcinit is a water-soluble calcium nitrate fertiliser supplied in a 25kg bag. The listed analysis provides nitrogen and calcium, two nutrients used in crop nutrition programmes. Its soluble form makes it suitable for fertigation and other application methods permitted by the manufacturer's instructions.

Calcium and nitrate nitrogen have different roles in plant nutrition. Select Calcinit when both nutrients fit the crop plan, rather than treating it as a universal feed. Use soil, water and crop information to set the rate, and check the label for the exact analysis and recommended application method.
bullets: Verify the Calcinit name and 25kg pack on delivery.
Follow the manufacturer's dissolution and application directions.

yaratera-calcinit-calcium-nitrate-fertil.heading: Mixing, storage and purchase checks
paragraphs: Calcium nitrate should not be mixed in concentrated stock solutions with phosphate or sulphate fertilisers unless compatibility guidance specifically allows it. Such combinations can form insoluble deposits. Review the fertigation plan before preparing a tank, and use separate stock solutions when recommended.

Keep the bag dry and closed between uses. Before buying Calcinit in Kenya, compare the exact 25kg pack and supplier stock status. Ask for the current label or technical sheet if the nutrient analysis or mixing procedure is important to your system.
bullets: Check water quality and tank-mix compatibility first.
Store away from moisture and incompatible materials.

omnia-potassium-nitrate-13-0-46-fertiliz.heading: Omnia Potassium Nitrate 13:0:46 for N and K
paragraphs: Omnia Potassium Nitrate is listed with an NPK analysis of 13:0:46, supplying nitrate nitrogen and potassium. The 25kg pack is a water-soluble fertiliser for programmes where both nutrients are required. It can be considered for fertigation or other application methods described on the product label.

Potassium nitrate does not supply phosphorus, so it should be used within a complete nutrient plan rather than as a stand-alone answer to every crop requirement. Compare the grade with other potassium sources and check whether the crop also needs nitrogen at the planned growth stage.
bullets: Check the 13:0:46 analysis on the Omnia bag.
Use the label rate for the crop and irrigation method.

omnia-potassium-nitrate-13-0-46-fertiliz.heading: Choosing a soluble potassium fertiliser
paragraphs: Potassium nitrate can be compared with SOP and MOP by looking at chloride content and accompanying nutrients. It supplies nitrate nitrogen and potassium, whereas SOP adds sulphur and MOP is a chloride source. These distinctions can influence suitability for chloride-sensitive crops and the overall fertiliser programme.

Store the 25kg bag in a dry, secure place and protect it from contamination. When ordering in Kenya, confirm the Omnia brand, 25kg pack and current stock with the supplier. Check tank-mix compatibility before combining it with other soluble products.
bullets: Consider crop sensitivity and the full nutrient budget.
Keep a record of the quantity used per field.

magnesium-sulphate-fertilizer-25kg.heading: Magnesium Sulphate for magnesium and sulphur
paragraphs: Magnesium Sulphate supplies magnesium and sulphur, nutrients that support normal crop development. It is used where soil or plant assessment indicates a magnesium deficiency or a need to supplement sulphur. The 25kg pack is suitable for growers who need a farm-scale quantity for a planned nutrient programme.

Magnesium deficiency can have several causes, so confirm the issue before applying a corrective fertiliser. Soil pH, root condition and nutrient interactions can affect uptake. Use a soil test or qualified agronomic advice to determine whether magnesium sulphate is appropriate and to set a suitable rate.
bullets: Check the pack size selected is 25kg, not 50kg.
Base corrective use on soil or crop assessment.

magnesium-sulphate-fertilizer-25kg.heading: Using and storing the 25kg pack
paragraphs: Magnesium sulphate may be used in soil or soluble feeding programmes depending on the product grade and label instructions. Confirm the exact analysis and solubility before using it in irrigation equipment. Avoid mixing concentrated fertiliser solutions without checking compatibility, particularly where calcium products are also used.

Keep the bag dry and sealed, and store it separately from food and animal feed. Compare supplier prices by pack weight and product grade, then keep a record of the field and rate where the product is applied.
bullets: Use clean equipment and measure the recommended quantity accurately.
Do not apply extra magnesium without checking the nutrient balance.

zinc-sulphate-fertilizer-25kg.heading: Zinc Sulphate as a crop micronutrient
paragraphs: Zinc Sulphate is a micronutrient fertiliser used to supply zinc where deficiency has been identified or is expected from soil and crop assessment. Zinc is involved in normal enzyme activity and plant development, but the amount required is much smaller than the quantities of nitrogen, phosphorus or potassium used in a fertiliser programme.

The 25kg pack is intended for farm-scale purchasing. Check the product grade and declared nutrient analysis before deciding on a rate, because zinc sulphate products can differ in concentration and hydration form. Use soil-test results or qualified advice to avoid applying more zinc than the crop needs.
bullets: Verify the zinc sulphate grade on the bag.
Measure carefully because micronutrient rates are comparatively small.

zinc-sulphate-fertilizer-25kg.heading: Planning zinc application and storage
paragraphs: Zinc deficiency symptoms can resemble other nutrient or root problems. Confirm the likely cause before treating the field, and consider soil pH and previous fertiliser applications. A balanced nutrient plan is more reliable than applying a micronutrient solely because leaves appear pale or growth is uneven.

Store the 25kg bag in a dry, secure location and keep it sealed after opening. When ordering zinc sulphate in Kenya, confirm the selected pack, supplier stock and delivery terms. Retain the label so future applications can be compared with the field record.
bullets: Use protective equipment and follow label handling advice.
Keep the product away from children, animals and food.

solubor-boron-fertilizer-1kg.heading: Solubor for correcting boron deficiency
paragraphs: Solubor is a highly soluble borate fertiliser listed for soil and foliar application. Boron is an essential micronutrient for plant growth, but crops need it in small quantities. The 1kg pack can suit growers treating a limited area or preparing measured foliar mixes where boron deficiency has been identified.

Boron has a narrow range between deficiency and excess. Do not increase the dose in an attempt to accelerate results, and do not assume that every crop or field requires boron. Check the product label for crop suitability and application rate, and use soil or plant analysis where possible.
bullets: Measure accurately with a suitable scale.
Confirm the recommended rate for the specific crop.

solubor-boron-fertilizer-1kg.heading: Safe handling of a soluble borate pack
paragraphs: Solubor dissolves in water for label-approved applications. Use clean water, mix thoroughly and avoid preparing a stronger solution than directed. If combining with other foliar products, check compatibility first and test a small area when the label recommends it.

Store the 1kg pack sealed in a cool, dry place. Keep it away from food, animal feed, children and pets. For Kenyan growers comparing boron fertilisers, check the exact product name and pack size so a different borate formulation is not substituted unintentionally.
bullets: Use gloves and follow the handling instructions on the pack.
Keep a record of the date and area treated.

easygro-starter-fertilizer-1kg.heading: Easygro Starter for early crop nutrition
paragraphs: Easygro Starter is listed as a water-soluble NPK 18:20:21 fertiliser with trace elements. It is designed for early growth stages where the crop programme calls for nitrogen and phosphorus alongside potassium. The 1kg pack is convenient for growers who mix smaller quantities for foliar feeding or fertigation.

The nutrient ratio is a guide to the product's composition, not a universal application instruction. Crop type, growth stage, water quality and the rest of the fertiliser programme all matter. Follow the current label for the correct dilution, interval and application method.
bullets: Check the NPK 18:20:21 formulation on the pack.
Dissolve the measured amount fully before application.

easygro-starter-fertilizer-1kg.heading: Using the 1kg pack in a feeding programme
paragraphs: Starter fertilisers are generally selected for the establishment phase, but the timing should match the crop and label. Avoid using a high-phosphorus product automatically on every field; soil tests can show whether phosphorus is already sufficient. Compare the product with other soluble feeds before choosing a programme.

Store the 1kg pack in a sealed container or its original packaging, away from humidity. When ordering Easygro Starter in Kenya, confirm that the product is the Starter formulation and not the Vegetative or Flower and Fruit variant.
bullets: Keep the original label for future reference.
Check tank-mix compatibility before combining soluble fertilisers.

easygro-vegetative-fertilizer-1kg.heading: Easygro Vegetative for foliage-stage nutrition
paragraphs: Easygro Vegetative is a soluble crystalline fertiliser listed with an NPK 27:10:16 formulation, trace elements and biostimulants. Its higher nitrogen proportion makes it relevant to crop stages when the nutrition plan calls for additional support for vegetative growth. The 1kg pack suits measured foliar or fertigation use.

Choose the Vegetative formulation only where it matches the crop's nutrient requirement. Excess nitrogen can encourage unwanted vegetative growth or disturb the balance with other nutrients. Use soil tests, crop stage and label directions to determine whether this blend is suitable for the field.
bullets: Check that the pack says Easygro Vegetative 27:10:16.
Measure the recommended quantity rather than estimating by eye.

easygro-vegetative-fertilizer-1kg.heading: How to compare Easygro formulations
paragraphs: Easygro Starter and Easygro Vegetative are different formulations for different crop nutrition stages. The Starter grade carries a different NPK balance, while Vegetative is higher in nitrogen. They should not be treated as interchangeable products simply because both dissolve in water and come in 1kg packs.

Before ordering, compare the formulation printed on the pack with the programme recommended for your crop. Keep the powder dry, reseal the bag after use and follow the label for mixing, timing and repeat intervals.
bullets: Use the formulation that matches the current crop stage.
Do not mix with other products unless compatibility is confirmed.

omex-calmax-calcium-foliar-fertilizer-1l.heading: Omex Calmax for calcium-focused foliar feeding
paragraphs: Omex Calmax is a liquid calcium foliar fertiliser. The supplier information describes a 22.5% calcium content together with a balanced range of micronutrients, and identifies fruit and vegetable crops as relevant users. The 1L bottle is a practical pack for growers planning measured foliar applications.

Calcium nutrition is linked to plant tissue development and fruit quality, but application timing and coverage matter. Select the product where the crop programme calls for calcium and follow the label for the rate and growth stage. Do not assume that foliar calcium can correct every soil or root-related problem.
bullets: Check the bottle label for calcium analysis and dilution rate.
Apply in suitable weather according to the product instructions.

omex-calmax-calcium-foliar-fertilizer-1l.heading: Compatibility and storage for the 1L bottle
paragraphs: Before adding Calmax to a spray tank, check compatibility with the other products in the mix. Calcium-containing solutions may react with concentrated phosphate or sulphate fertilisers. If the label calls for a jar test or separate application, follow that advice rather than risking deposits or blocked equipment.

Keep the bottle tightly closed after use and store it away from direct sunlight and excessive heat. When buying Omex Calmax in Kenya, verify the 1L pack and current product label. Retain the label for reference when planning repeat applications.
bullets: Measure with a clean graduated container.
Keep the product away from children and animal feed.

wuxal-macromix-foliar-fertilizer-1l.heading: Wuxal Macromix as a multi-nutrient foliar feed
paragraphs: Wuxal Macromix is listed as a foliar nutrient suspension with an NPK 24:24:18 formulation and trace elements. It can supplement a crop nutrition programme when several major nutrients and micronutrients are required together. The 1L bottle suits growers who prepare measured spray volumes for field or horticultural use.

Foliar fertilisers are supplements, not automatic replacements for soil-applied nutrients. The correct rate depends on the crop, growth stage and label directions. Check the declared nutrient analysis and dilution instructions on the bottle before preparing a spray, and avoid applying in unsuitable weather.
bullets: Confirm the Wuxal Macromix formulation and 1L pack.
Use the label rate and a calibrated measuring container.

wuxal-macromix-foliar-fertilizer-1l.heading: Tank-mix and application checks
paragraphs: Before combining Wuxal Macromix with crop protection products or other foliar feeds, check compatibility and any restrictions on the label. A small jar test can help identify visible incompatibility where recommended. Use clean spray equipment and ensure the solution is mixed evenly before application.

Store the bottle in its original packaging, protected from extreme temperatures. When comparing Wuxal products in Kenya, distinguish Macromix from other Wuxal formulations because nutrient ratios and recommended uses can differ.
bullets: Do not assume all Wuxal products share the same analysis.
Record the crop, spray date and dilution used.

kelpak-seaweed-biostimulant-1l.heading: Kelpak seaweed extract in crop programmes
paragraphs: Kelpak is a liquid seaweed-derived biostimulant made from Ecklonia maxima. It is used as a supplement in crop programmes where growers want to support plant establishment, root development or the response to environmental stress. The 1L bottle is suitable for farm and horticultural users who need a measured liquid pack.

A biostimulant is not a substitute for balanced fertiliser, irrigation or good crop management. Choose Kelpak as part of a wider programme and follow the manufacturer's label for crop suitability, rate and timing. Avoid assuming that a single application guarantees stronger growth or higher yields.
bullets: Check the bottle is the 1L Kelpak pack.
Use the label rate for the crop and application method.

kelpak-seaweed-biostimulant-1l.heading: Planning a seaweed biostimulant application
paragraphs: Kelpak can be compared with other seaweed-based products by checking the source material, formulation, pack size and label directions. The exact application schedule can vary by crop and method, so rely on the current product label rather than a generic internet rate.

Store the bottle sealed in a cool place away from direct sunlight. When ordering in Kenya, confirm availability and delivery for the 1L bottle. Keep a record of the crop stage and application date so the product's role in the overall crop programme can be reviewed.
bullets: Do not use the product as the only source of plant nutrients.
Check compatibility before mixing with other spray products.

solumest-iron-eddha-6-fertilizer-1kg.heading: Solumest Iron-EDDHA 6% for iron deficiency
paragraphs: Solumest Iron-EDDHA 6% is a water-soluble iron chelate containing 6% iron. It is used to prevent or correct iron deficiency, including chlorosis associated with alkaline or high-pH soils where iron can become less available to plants. The 1kg pack is suited to targeted crop nutrition programmes.

EDDHA chelation helps keep iron available across a broad pH range, but the product should still be used only where the crop needs it. Yellowing leaves can have several causes, so check soil conditions and crop symptoms before applying. Follow the label for the approved application method and rate.
bullets: Verify the 6% iron analysis and 1kg pack.
Use soil or crop assessment to confirm the need for iron.

solumest-iron-eddha-6-fertilizer-1kg.heading: Choosing a chelated iron product in Kenya
paragraphs: When comparing chelated iron products, check the chelate type, percentage of water-soluble iron and pack size. Different iron chelates can perform differently across soil pH conditions. Solumest Iron-EDDHA 6% is a specific formulation; do not substitute another iron product without comparing its technical information.

Store the micro-granular product in its original sealed pack, protected from moisture. Keep application records and review whether the crop responds as expected. If deficiency symptoms persist, seek agronomic advice rather than repeatedly increasing the dose.
bullets: Follow the supplier label rather than a guessed dose.
Keep the pack away from food, feed and children.

blackearth-85-wsg-humic-acid-fertilizer-.heading: BlackEarth 85 WSG as a humic-acid soil amendment
paragraphs: BlackEarth 85 WSG is listed as a water-soluble soil amendment containing 85% humic acid, together with soluble potassium and trace elements. It is intended to form part of a soil fertility programme focused on soil structure, water retention and nutrient availability. The 1kg pack suits smaller farm or horticultural applications.

Humic products complement good soil management but do not replace organic matter, balanced fertilisers or appropriate irrigation. Select the product according to the soil condition and the supplier's label. Check the stated composition and recommended use before mixing it with other fertilisers.
bullets: Confirm the 85 WSG formulation and 1kg pack.
Use the label rate for the crop or soil programme.

blackearth-85-wsg-humic-acid-fertilizer-.heading: Mixing, application and storage
paragraphs: The supplier lists a mixing guide for BlackEarth 85 WSG; use the current pack instructions for the correct quantity and application method. Avoid increasing the rate without advice. If mixing with other soluble products, check compatibility and prepare only the amount needed for the planned application.

Keep the 1kg pack sealed and dry. Store it away from direct moisture and contamination, and retain the label for future reference. When comparing humic acid products in Kenya, check the percentage, formulation and pack size because products with similar names may not have the same concentration.
bullets: Measure the powder accurately and dissolve as directed.
Treat it as a soil amendment, not a complete fertiliser.

algreen-bonzin-foliar-fertilizer-1l.heading: Algreen Bonzin Foliar Fertilizer 1L: product role and crop fit
paragraphs: Algreen Bonzin Foliar Fertilizer 1L is listed for zinc and boron nutrition for flowering and fruiting. It is most useful when the crop, growth stage and nutrient or spray requirement match the formulation. For tomatoes, peppers, onions, fruit trees and flowering crops, compare the declared composition with the farm's existing soil-fertility and crop-protection plan before selecting a treatment.

The supplier lists 10% zinc and 15% boron with a stimulant, and a foliar guide of 20–30 ml per 20 litres of water. This product should be used as a planned input, not as a promise of a particular yield or a replacement for good agronomy. Correct irrigation, soil condition, crop nutrition and timing remain important. The current manufacturer label takes priority over general online guidance.
bullets: Check that the delivered Algreen Bonzin Foliar Fertilizer 1L is the stated 1L variant before opening the pack.
Match Algreen Bonzin Foliar Fertilizer 1L to the crop stage and directions on its own label.

algreen-bonzin-foliar-fertilizer-1l.heading: Using Algreen Bonzin Foliar Fertilizer 1L responsibly in Kenya
paragraphs: Before using Algreen Bonzin Foliar Fertilizer 1L, read the full label, verify the recommended rate and calibrate the equipment or measuring container. For foliar products, apply evenly under suitable weather conditions; for adjuvants, confirm compatibility with each spray-tank ingredient. Do not increase the concentration to force a faster response.

When comparing Algreen Bonzin Foliar Fertilizer 1L with alternatives, check pack size, nutrient analysis or active ingredient, formulation, source and current supplier price. Keep the original container and purchase record for traceability. Store it sealed in the conditions stated by the manufacturer, away from food, animal feed, children and direct sunlight.
bullets: Keep a dated application record for Algreen Bonzin Foliar Fertilizer 1L and the treated crop.
Seek crop-specific advice if symptoms persist after using Algreen Bonzin Foliar Fertilizer 1L as directed.

algreen-supa-k-high-potassium-foliar-fer.heading: Algreen Supa-K High Potassium Foliar Fertilizer 1L: product role and crop fit
paragraphs: Algreen Supa-K High Potassium Foliar Fertilizer 1L is listed for potassium support during fruit development and quality-focused crop stages. It is most useful when the crop, growth stage and nutrient or spray requirement match the formulation. For tomatoes, watermelons, potatoes and fruit crops, compare the declared composition with the farm's existing soil-fertility and crop-protection plan before selecting a treatment.

The supplier describes a 6:0:42 NPK formulation with trace elements and stimulant, with label guidance of 30–50 ml per 20 litres. This product should be used as a planned input, not as a promise of a particular yield or a replacement for good agronomy. Correct irrigation, soil condition, crop nutrition and timing remain important. The current manufacturer label takes priority over general online guidance.
bullets: Check that the delivered Algreen Supa-K High Potassium Foliar Fertilizer 1L is the stated 1L variant before opening the pack.
Match Algreen Supa-K High Potassium Foliar Fertilizer 1L to the crop stage and directions on its own label.

algreen-supa-k-high-potassium-foliar-fer.heading: Using Algreen Supa-K High Potassium Foliar Fertilizer 1L responsibly in Kenya
paragraphs: Before using Algreen Supa-K High Potassium Foliar Fertilizer 1L, read the full label, verify the recommended rate and calibrate the equipment or measuring container. For foliar products, apply evenly under suitable weather conditions; for adjuvants, confirm compatibility with each spray-tank ingredient. Do not increase the concentration to force a faster response.

When comparing Algreen Supa-K High Potassium Foliar Fertilizer 1L with alternatives, check pack size, nutrient analysis or active ingredient, formulation, source and current supplier price. Keep the original container and purchase record for traceability. Store it sealed in the conditions stated by the manufacturer, away from food, animal feed, children and direct sunlight.
bullets: Keep a dated application record for Algreen Supa-K High Potassium Foliar Fertilizer 1L and the treated crop.
Seek crop-specific advice if symptoms persist after using Algreen Supa-K High Potassium Foliar Fertilizer 1L as directed.

goldchance-super-flowers-fruits-fertiliz.heading: Goldchance Super Flowers & Fruits Fertilizer: product role and crop fit
paragraphs: Goldchance Super Flowers & Fruits Fertilizer is listed for nutrition for flowering, fruit set and fruit development. It is most useful when the crop, growth stage and nutrient or spray requirement match the formulation. For vegetables, orchard crops and flowering plants, compare the declared composition with the farm's existing soil-fertility and crop-protection plan before selecting a treatment.

The supplier lists this high-potassium product for flowering and fruiting; confirm the exact pack variant and nutrient analysis from the label. This product should be used as a planned input, not as a promise of a particular yield or a replacement for good agronomy. Correct irrigation, soil condition, crop nutrition and timing remain important. The current manufacturer label takes priority over general online guidance.
bullets: Check that the delivered Goldchance Super Flowers & Fruits Fertilizer is the stated listed variant before opening the pack.

Follow the label for room evacuation, ventilation, re-entry and any cleaning required after treatment. Never puncture or burn an aerosol can, even when empty. Store it in its original packaging in a cool, dry place and keep it out of reach of children. If the product contacts skin or eyes, follow the first-aid instructions printed on the container and seek medical advice when directed.

Spraying alone may not resolve the conditions that attract insects. Keep food in sealed containers, clean spills promptly, empty rubbish bins, repair gaps around doors and windows, and remove standing water where mosquitoes breed. For persistent cockroach or crawling-insect activity, identify harbourage areas and consider an integrated treatment plan rather than repeatedly spraying without addressing entry points and sanitation.
